objective: Implement the first real P3-002 Browser Session Service product slice on the landed P3-001 bundled runtime: isolated ephemeral and persistent browser contexts, local profile-state persistence, bounded session/page/profile quotas, request-correlated page lifecycle operations, and deterministic cleanup. Keep the service application-owned and offline at runtime. The workflow path is exact self-removing transport only and must be restored before the product commit. Do not spend this Work Order on readiness prose, governance expansion, observations/actions beyond session lifecycle, or platform/release/production/GA promotion.
requiredTests: ephemeral contexts never restore or persist profile state
persistent profiles restore exact local storage state without cross-profile leakage
session, page, and persistent-profile quotas fail closed
invalid profile/session/page identifiers and unknown operations fail closed
shutdown closes every page/context and terminates the browser tree
Dart request correlation, timeout, and close behavior remain deterministic
self-removing materializer does not survive the effective product diff
exact-head Node tests and Product Gates
